Trump faces midterm verdict with control of Congress at stake

American voters will deliver a verdict on the first two years of President Donald Trump's second term in Tuesday's midterm elections, with polls and nonpartisan analysts favoring Democrats to wrest the House of Representatives from Republicans while control of the Senate remains uncertain.

Trump says US will stop $4 billion in funding to Israel at end of 2026

President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he made ​a deal with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Washington would stop $4 billion in funding to Israel after the end of ‌this year.

U.S. President Donald Trump speaks to the media next to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu upon arrival for meetings at Trump's Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach, Florida, U.S., December 29, 2025. REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst
1 hour ago
Iran-US deal still out of reach despite diplomatic push, Iranian official says

Iran and the United States are still far from a deal to end their war, a senior Iranian official told Reuters, while mediator Qatar stepped up ​efforts to bridge differences and avert a renewed escalation after the US midterm elections.

New cyberattack on supermarket fridges sweeps across Europe

Freezers are emptied at ICA Kvantum in Sjobo, Sweden. Johan Nilsson/TT News Agency/via REUTERS
